title: Independent verification: R420 frames by exterior algebra and odd-prime witnesses
head: b41e73169430641be18c988c659d2855a6a6218a
body:
## Result and scope

**Independent finite verification; no new kappa.** This adds an exterior-algebra audit of all 672 frames in the selected PR543 R420 bit word. Every orthogonal projector has common denominator 1, 2 or 4. Exact basis-content and residual witnesses show that the listed root spans, ranks, closure and used nesting relations survive over every odd prime-power ring.

The verifier uses integer wedge products and contractions. It imports no predecessor rank, Hermite reduction, determinant, Gram checker or geometry implementation. This independently corroborates the selected finite geometry and adds explicit witnesses for all 66,240 nonincidences. It does not remove other prime restrictions or prove the conditional multiplication theorem.

Only `research/r420-exterior-audit/` is added: verifier, full exact certificate, source pins, proof/review note and local sprint claim. `upstream/`, supplier code and the selected frontier are unchanged.

## Reproduce

Python 3.9+, standard library only, offline and without writes:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/r420-exterior-audit/verify.py
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_R420_EXTERIOR_GEOMETRY: 672 frames; 2460 nested pairs; 258 positive oracles; 11 rejected controls
```

Coverage includes all 80,640 frame/root incidence tests and all 2,940 persistent-register moves. The closed A2 control `[0,16,23]` has denominator 3 despite rational closure; separate controls expose odd basis index, incidence appearing modulo 3, nondecomposable exterior input and illegal frame moves. These are deliberately excluded alternatives, not defects in the selected word.

## Validation and provenance

- The full certificate matches on macOS arm64 with Python 3.9.6 and 3.14.8, including optimized execution.
- A separate AI-assisted Fraction Gram-Schmidt/minor implementation matched every projector entry, exterior coordinate, basis-content witness and transition. Six in-memory implementation mutations were detected; recompression is accepted while altered payload/certificate contents are rejected.
- `make selected-record-check`, the unchanged PR543 660-column `xcheck.py`, local links and whitespace checks pass.
- Base: `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`. PR543: `2065fe4f72a914d907f1046603f5a36f17018535`. Selected consuming #626: `660de893d27bb7abd1d5b01b1640207528a5c851`. Assignment seed **83**, independent-verification track.
- Initial scan covered 535 open PRs; submission refresh covered 549 through #730 and then the new #731/#732 heads. No pinned coordination issue exists, so the completed claim is local. #707/#709 optimize existing geometry checks, #612 formalizes boundaries, #718 studies split reads, #726 studies A2 gathers, #729 audits complex lifetimes, #731 checks a binary compensation kernel and #732 studies star punctures. None is imported or duplicated by this implementation.

Credit: eumemic's R420 word and checker, Dylan Crow's E8 format/export and Gram checks, the source/shared-label lineage credited by PR543, Chafik Boukhalfa's consuming #626 and Douglas Colkitt's review. Prepared by **Sagar Thakrar / @thakrarsagar with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**, under Apache-2.0. No independent human review is claimed.

All-size realization, scalar semantics beyond the separately rerun predecessor check, hosting, precision/tape and analytic obligations remain inherited. The full repository suite, selected cold replay, native cohort replay, Linux CI and Lean were not rerun.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
